name: ReadyGo Gift Wrap – Gift Wrapping, Gift Message & Wrapping Fee for WooCommerce
author: mkbplatinum

sections.description:
Give shoppers the option to gift wrap their order — WooCommerce has no built-in way to do this. ReadyGo Gift Wrap for WooCommerce adds a tidy “Add gift wrapping” option to the checkout, charges the fee you set, and lets customers include a gift message. The choice and message are saved to the order and shown to you for fulfillment.

Built by ReadyGo Tools, a division of MKB Platinum.

  • One-click at checkout — a gift-wrap checkbox with your fee, plus an optional gift message.
  • Your fee, your wording — set the price and the labels. Free wrapping? Set the fee to 0.
  • Saved to the order — gift-wrap status and message appear on the order in the admin, on the customer’s confirmation, and in emails.
  • Fast & lightweight — assets load only on the checkout page.
  • No AI, no scraping, no external services — everything runs on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Gift Wrap to set your fee and labels. The option appears on checkout right away.
sections.faq:
Where does the gift-wrap option appear?

On the checkout page, in the customer details area. Customers tick it, optionally add a message, and the fee is added to their total.

Does WooCommerce include gift wrapping already?

No. WooCommerce has no gift-wrap or gift-message feature — this plugin adds it.

Can wrapping be free?

Yes. Set the fee to 0 and the option still shows (without a charge).

Where do I see the gift message?

On the order screen in your admin, and it is included on the customer’s order confirmation and emails.
